name: Kale Side Dish
directions: Fill a bowl with water and ice
Bring a pot of water to a boil and add salt. Once boiled, add kale and blanch for about 30 seconds to 1 minute
With tongs, take kale out of pot and straight into the ice water
With a cheesecloth or hands, squeeze out all water from the kale
In bowl, mix all the seasonings well
Add the kale and hand toss until well incorporated
